en.title: Lexicographically Smallest by Reversing Prefix or Suffix
en.description:
Given a lowercase string, reverse exactly one non-empty prefix or suffix exactly once, and find the lexicographically smallest of all results.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: A non-empty lowercase string; this site adds |word|≤2000 so that all candidates can be enumerated directly.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
